text:
1. 上半年我国集成电路出口额同比增长88.7%。
2. SK崔泰源：明年半导体需求至少增五成。
3. SK崔泰源：内存应该降价，如果一直高价消费电子行业可能受到冲击。
4. SK崔泰源：正筹划在美国建厂，以增加供应并应对价格异常高企。
text_en:
1. In the first half of the year, China's integrated circuit export value increased by 88.7% year-on-year.
2. SK's Choi Tae-won: Semiconductor demand will increase by at least 50% next year.
3. SK's Choi Tae-won: Memory prices should drop; persistently high prices could impact the consumer electronics industry.
4. SK's Choi Tae-won: Planning to build a factory in the US to increase supply and address abnormally high prices.
